objective: Close missing one-B70 stock-package headlines without reusing the untracked 2026-08-22 summaries.

fixed_contract.primary_metric: median of per-class median decode rates over generated events 1-100 after TTFT

freshness: Stop the server after each attempt and start a new process for the next attempt.
qualification: Both attempts must run the complete fixed suite exactly once.
Every request must report cached_tokens=0 and cover the 100-event metric window under the 512-token cap.
Both independent objective canary batteries must pass.
All 12 complete streamed token-ID arrays must match between fresh servers.
Model, server, backend libraries, suite, harness, canary script, repository commit, command, and environment identities must be retained and hash-bound.
The published value is the median of the two fresh-server class-balanced medians; both attempt values and their relative range remain visible.
new_family_quality_boundary: These are unmodified stock-model packages, so no cross-model oracle exists. Fresh-server complete-token identity plus objective self-consistency, arithmetic, copy, and JSON canaries is the registered package quality gate. Any later optimization requires a matched stock oracle.
fail_closed: Do not restore the old 132.351606, 72.169452, or 49.588381 observations as headlines merely because a new run is similar.
A failed profile remains strict headline pending and its evidence is preserved.
No headline result transfers to 32K, concurrency, another quantization, another runtime, or another topology.
